notes: All 94 published dishes compared with an independent parser of the page (8 nutrient cells incl. kJ, 14 allergen columns contains/may, cereal and tree-nut names): no extraction error. The 18 'nutrition mismatches' are the page contradicting itself: its printed kJ and kcal disagree by 7-15% (sushi rolls: kcal about 10% above kJ and their own macros; teriyaki/noodle/rice dishes: kJ about 10% above kcal and macros; Cod Bites 1447 kJ vs 254 kcal), so those 18 are held back by a rule in tools/uk_extract/yo_sushi.py instead of choosing a figure.
